_about: Local HMO planning (Article 4) and licensing rules per town, researched from council websites and landlord press. Shown in each town report as a 'Local HMO rules' box. Rules change often - re-check and update 'checked' at least every six months.

Birmingham.article4_detail: Citywide Article 4 for C3 to C4 small HMOs since 8 June 2020.
Birmingham.additional_detail: Citywide scheme for 3-4 person HMOs, 5 June 2023 to around June 2028.
Birmingham.selective_detail: 25 of 69 wards from 5 June 2023 for 5 years - use the council's ward checker.
Birmingham.other_notes: Fees: additional HMO licence £755; selective licence £700.

Manchester.article4_detail: Citywide Article 4 for 3-6 person HMOs since 8 October 2011; Core Strategy Policy H11 restricts clustering.
Manchester.additional_detail: No additional HMO licensing scheme - mandatory licensing (5+ people) only.
Manchester.selective_detail: Areas incl. Clayton/Openshaw, Harpurhey, Gorton, Longsight, Rusholme, Levenshulme, Moss Side, Cheetham, Crumpsall (schemes 2022-2030).

Leeds.article4_detail: Covers inner areas incl. Headingley, Hyde Park & Woodhouse, Kirkstall, Armley, Beeston, Harehills and Chapel Allerton.
Leeds.additional_detail: No current additional HMO licensing scheme - mandatory licensing only.
Leeds.selective_detail: Parts of Armley, Beeston & Holbeck, Burmantofts, Harehills, Hunslet & Riverside, Farnley & Wortley, Feb 2026 to Feb 2031.

Liverpool.article4_detail: 11 wards (3+ person HMOs) plus The Dales, in force 17 June 2021.
Liverpool.additional_detail: No additional HMO licensing scheme - mandatory licensing only.
Liverpool.selective_detail: 16 wards, April 2022 to March 2027. Consultation (to 5 Oct 2026) includes a possible return to citywide licensing.
Liverpool.other_notes: Proposed selective licence fee for the next scheme around £995.

Sheffield.article4_detail: West Sheffield area (Broomhill, Crookes, Walkley and surrounds) since December 2011.
Sheffield.additional_detail: None at present. In March 2026 the council voted to develop a citywide landlord licensing scheme - no dates yet.
Sheffield.selective_detail: Earlier area schemes ended by early 2024; a new citywide scheme is being developed.
Sheffield.other_notes: HMO licence holders must complete landlord training within a year of the licence being issued.

Bristol.article4_detail: Covers central wards and large parts of north, south and east Bristol; further wards added from 1 January 2027.
Bristol.additional_detail: Citywide additional HMO licensing from 6 August 2024, running to around 2029.
Bristol.selective_detail: Bishopston & Ashley Down, Cotham and Easton wards from August 2024.

Nottingham.article4_detail: Citywide Article 4 for 3-6 person HMOs since 2012; the council says new permissions are 'highly unlikely' in many areas.
Nottingham.additional_detail: Citywide for 3+ occupants in 2+ households, January 2024 to December 2028.

Leicester.article4_detail: Defined areas since 2014, widened November 2022; new HMOs usually refused there - check the council map.
Leicester.additional_detail: No additional HMO licensing scheme - mandatory licensing only.
Leicester.selective_detail: Parts of Braunstone Park & Rowley Fields, Fosse, Westcotes, Stoneygate and Saffron, October 2022 to October 2027.

Coventry.article4_detail: 11 wards incl. St Michael's, Earlsdon, Foleshill, Radford, Lower/Upper Stoke, Cheylesmore, Westwood, Whoberley - since September 2023.
Coventry.additional_detail: Citywide scheme for 3-4 person HMOs, May 2025 to May 2030.

Derby.article4_detail: All of Arboretum ward plus inner-ring-road parts of Abbey, Alvaston North, Darley, Mackworth, Normanton and Sinfin - since 3 May 2025.
Derby.additional_detail: No additional HMO licensing - mandatory licensing (5+ people) only.
Derby.other_notes: The council has reported a backlog of HMO licence applications.

Stoke-on-Trent.article4_detail: None in force, but a citywide Article 4 with ward caps was proposed in August 2026.
Stoke-on-Trent.additional_detail: A citywide scheme for smaller HMOs is proposed and consulting (2026) - not yet in force.
Stoke-on-Trent.other_notes: Rules are changing fast here - check with the council before buying.

Lincoln.article4_detail: Covers the whole City of Lincoln area since 1 March 2016.
Lincoln.additional_detail: No scheme found - appears to be mandatory licensing only.
Lincoln.other_notes: An HMO planning document controls how many HMOs are allowed in an area.

Dudley.article4_detail: Borough-wide Article 4 for C3 to C4 since 15 September 2023.
Dudley.additional_detail: No additional HMO licensing - mandatory licensing only.

Wolverhampton.additional_detail: 3-4 tenant HMOs do not need a licence - mandatory licensing (5+) only.
Wolverhampton.selective_detail: No scheme found on the council website.
Wolverhampton.other_notes: Mandatory HMO licence around £1,550 in two parts.

Walsall.additional_detail: Palfrey, Paddock, Pleck and St Matthews wards (3+ tenants), September 2022 to August 2027.

Newcastle upon Tyne.article4_detail: Parts of Heaton, Jesmond, South Gosforth, Sandyford, Spital Tongues and surrounding areas (2011-2013).
Newcastle upon Tyne.additional_detail: Citywide for HMOs of 3+ people in 2+ households; current scheme from April 2025.
Newcastle upon Tyne.selective_detail: Several areas incl. parts of Benwell, Cowgate, West End; Byker/High Cross from October 2026.
Newcastle upon Tyne.other_notes: HMO planning applications judged against the 'Maintaining Sustainable Communities' guidance.

Sunderland.article4_detail: Former Barnes, Hendon, Millfield, St Michael's and St Peter's wards since December 2013.
Sunderland.selective_detail: No current selective licensing scheme (earlier scheme lapsed).

Middlesbrough.article4_detail: Whole borough (excluding the Development Corporation area) since 8 February 2025.
Middlesbrough.additional_detail: No additional HMO licensing; small HMOs in selective areas need a selective licence.

Hull.article4_detail: Inner areas incl. Beverley Road South, Spring Bank, Anlaby Road, Hessle Road and Holderness Road West.
Hull.other_notes: Planning guidance resists HMOs that would sandwich a family home or create 3+ adjacent HMOs.

Bradford.council: City of Bradford Metropolitan District Council
Bradford.article4_detail: No HMO Article 4 at present; a district-wide Article 4 motion is due at full council in October 2026.
Bradford.other_notes: Watch the October 2026 council decision on Article 4.

Huddersfield.other_notes: The council reports delays on HMO licence applications.

Wakefield.article4_detail: Six areas since 24 October 2025: Castleford Centre North, Smawthorne, Agbrigg, College Grove, Lincoln Street, Peterson Road.

York.article4_detail: Covers the main urban area of York, not the outer villages.
York.additional_detail: Eight wards incl. Clifton, Fishergate, Fulford & Heslington, Guildhall, Heworth, Hull Road - 3-4 person HMOs since April 2023.
York.other_notes: Planning guidance limits HMO concentration by neighbourhood and street.

Doncaster.article4_detail: Central Doncaster since October 2019 (Town, Town Fields, Wheatley, Hexthorpe, Balby, Intake, Belle Vue).

Preston.article4_detail: Seven inner wards since 2012; a citywide direction would start 15 February 2027 if confirmed.
Preston.selective_detail: Proposed for City Centre, St Matthew's and Plungington - consultation to 11 October 2026.

Bolton.article4_detail: Borough-wide Article 4 since June 2025 - planning permission needed for all new HMOs.
Bolton.additional_detail: Borough-wide scheme for 3+ person HMOs approved August 2026, expected to start early 2027 (around £1,211 for 5 years).

Blackpool.additional_detail: Current status unclear - check with the council.
Blackpool.selective_detail: Inner-area scheme from April 2025 across eight central wards.

Stockport.article4_detail: Cabinet approved a borough-wide immediate Article 4 on 15 September 2026 - may take effect at very short notice.

Oldham.selective_detail: Designated areas across about 11 wards, July 2022 to July 2027.

Warrington.article4_detail: Six central wards confirmed May 2026; a borough-wide immediate direction started 25 September 2026.
Warrington.other_notes: New HMO planning guidance with space standards (2026).

Chester.article4_detail: Garden Quarter area of Chester only, since July 2013.
Chester.other_notes: Local Plan policy DM28 controls HMO concentration.

Telford.article4_detail: Borough-wide direction confirmed February 2026, in force from 27 February 2027.
Telford.additional_detail: A scheme due August 2026 was revoked in September 2026 after a legal challenge; to be reviewed in 2027.
Telford.other_notes: Small HMO conversions remain permitted development until 27 February 2027.

Worcester.additional_detail: Citywide for HMOs of 3+ people in 2+ households, extended to 2030.

Gloucester.article4_detail: Six wards incl. Kingsholm & Wotton, Westgate, Barton & Tredworth - in force from 3 March 2027.
Gloucester.additional_detail: Citywide scheme for 3-4 person HMOs from 21 September 2026.

Northampton.article4_detail: The whole former Northampton borough area is covered.
Northampton.additional_detail: Designated area of Northampton for 3-4 occupier HMOs, February 2025 to February 2030.
Northampton.other_notes: Planning policy limits HMOs to 10% concentration.

Peterborough.article4_detail: A trial direction (Fletton, Woodston, Hampton, Park) expired January 2026; the council is considering reinstating it.
Peterborough.additional_detail: Citywide for 3-4 person HMOs, January 2026 to January 2031.
Peterborough.selective_detail: 10 wards incl. Central, East, North, Park, Bretton, Fletton & Woodston, March 2024 to March 2029.

Luton.article4_detail: No Article 4 yet; the council is gathering evidence for one.
Luton.additional_detail: Borough-wide for 3-4 person HMOs since February 2024 (applications currently paused).
Luton.selective_detail: Town centre and Park Town areas since June 2026.

Reading.article4_detail: Parts of Park, Redlands and Katesgrove wards, plus Jesse Terrace.
Reading.additional_detail: Borough-wide for 3+ person HMOs, March 2026 to February 2031.
Reading.selective_detail: None yet - planned for Battle ward, possibly Park and Redlands later.

Oxford.additional_detail: Citywide for all HMOs; new five-year scheme from June 2026.
Oxford.other_notes: Every HMO in Oxford needs a licence.

Cambridge.article4_detail: No HMO Article 4; a cabinet report on one is expected in autumn 2026.

Norwich.additional_detail: Citywide scheme going to consultation from September 2026 (proposed fee around £1,000).
Norwich.selective_detail: Proposed for Nelson, Mile Cross, Sewell and Town Close wards in the same consultation.

Ipswich.article4_detail: Parts of 12 wards since June 2024, incl. St Margaret's, Westgate, Gainsborough, Priory Heath, Alexandra, Bridge.

Southampton.additional_detail: Nine wards incl. Bargate, Bassett, Bevois, Portswood, Shirley, Swaythling, October 2025 to September 2030.

Portsmouth.article4_detail: Citywide - planning permission needed for all new HMOs.
Portsmouth.additional_detail: Citywide for 3-4 occupants, September 2023 to August 2028.

Brighton.additional_detail: Citywide for 3+ people in 2+ households, July 2024 to June 2029.
Brighton.selective_detail: Several areas from September 2024, with Central Hove and Regency added from October 2026.

Exeter.article4_detail: Areas around the university campuses, expanded December 2024.

Plymouth.article4_detail: 11 neighbourhoods since 2012 incl. Mutley & Greenbank, City Centre, Stoke, Stonehouse, Peverell, Lipson & Laira.

Cardiff.article4_detail: Wales: every C3 to C4 change needs planning permission; refusal likely above 20% concentration in Cathays/Plasnewydd, 10% elsewhere.
Cardiff.selective_detail: Not used; Rent Smart Wales registration applies to all lets.

Swansea.article4_detail: Wales: planning permission needed for all small HMO changes of use.
Swansea.additional_detail: All HMOs in Castle, Uplands, St Thomas and Waterfront wards from February 2026.
Swansea.selective_detail: Not used; Rent Smart Wales registration applies to all lets.

Newport.article4_detail: Wales: planning permission needed for all small HMO changes of use.
Newport.additional_detail: Citywide for 3+ people in 2+ households, February 2025 to February 2030.
Newport.selective_detail: Not used; Rent Smart Wales registration applies to all lets.

Glasgow.article4_detail: Scotland: planning controls HMO concentration (around 5% per street/block); Hillhead and Woodlands closed to new HMOs.
Glasgow.additional_detail: Scotland-wide: HMO licence needed for 3+ unrelated occupants.
Glasgow.selective_detail: Not used in Scotland; landlord registration applies instead.

Edinburgh.article4_detail: Scotland: planning needed where more than 5 unrelated people share; assessed case by case.
Edinburgh.additional_detail: Scotland-wide: HMO licence needed for 3+ unrelated occupants.
Edinburgh.selective_detail: Not used in Scotland; landlord registration applies instead.
Edinburgh.other_notes: Whole city is a short-term let control area.

Long Eaton.article4_detail: Confirmed March 2026, in force from 6 March 2027 - covers large parts of Long Eaton, Ilkeston, Sawley and Sandiacre.
Long Eaton.other_notes: Small HMO conversions remain permitted development until 6 March 2027.

Burton upon Trent.article4_detail: Mapped area of Burton since April 2023.
Burton upon Trent.selective_detail: Anglesey, Burton & Eton and Shobnall wards, September 2022 to September 2027.
